properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.OTP.SendOTPInEmail
properties.description: Enable to send OTP in verification e-mail instead of confirmation code.

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.OTP.UseUppercaseCharactersInOTP
properties.description: Enable to include uppercase characters in SMS and e-mail OTPs.

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.OTP.UseLowercaseCharactersInOTP
properties.description: Enable to include lowercase characters in SMS and e-mail OTPs.

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.OTP.UseNumbersInOTP
properties.description: Enable to include numbers in SMS and e-mail OTPs.

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.OTP.OTPLength
properties.description: Length of the OTP for SMS and e-mail verifications. OTP length must be 4-10.

properties.name: Recovery.Question.Password.MinAnswers
properties.displayName: Number of questions required for password recovery

properties.name: Recovery.Question.Password.ReCaptcha.Enable
properties.displayName: Enable reCaptcha for security questions based password recovery
properties.description: Prompt reCaptcha for security question based password recovery

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Username.Email.Enable
properties.displayName: Notification based username recovery via EMAIL

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Username.SMS.Enable
properties.displayName: Notification based username recovery via SMS

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.InternallyManage
properties.description: Disable if the client application handles notification sending

properties.name: Recovery.Question.Password.NotifyStart
properties.displayName: Notify when security questions based recovery starts

properties.name: Recovery.ExpiryTime
properties.displayName: Recovery link expiry time in minutes

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.ExpiryTime.smsOtp
properties.description: Expiration time of the SMS OTP code for password recovery

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.smsOtp.Regex
properties.description: Regex for SMS OTP in format [allowed characters]{length}. Supported character ranges are a-z, A-Z, 0-9. Minimum OTP length is 4

properties.name: Recovery.Question.Password.Forced.Enable
properties.description: Force users to provide answers to security questions during sign in

properties.name: Recovery.Question.MinQuestionsToAnswer
properties.displayName: Minimum number of forced security questions to be answered
properties.description: Force users to provide answers to security questions during sign in if user has answered lesser than this value

properties.name: Recovery.AutoLogin.Enable
properties.displayName: Enable Auto Login After Password Reset
properties.description: User will be logged in automatically after completing the Password Reset wizard

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.MaxFailedAttempts
properties.displayName: Max failed attempts for password recovery

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.MaxResendAttempts
properties.displayName: Max resend attempts for password recovery

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.emailLink.Enable
properties.displayName: Notification based password recovery via an email

properties.name: Recovery.Notification.Password.smsOtp.Enable
properties.displayName: Notification based password recovery using SMS OTP
